name: Native instance bind query lists the binds a player can reset
contract: The original client sends C_LootLockout.QueryInstanceBinds() as the empty CMSG_QUERY_INSTANCE_BINDS (0x06FD) at every world entry and instance info update. Extensions.dll reads SMSG 0x06FE as a result C string, then on QUERY_INSTANCE_BINDS_OK u32 count and count x {u32, u32 map, u32 difficulty}; C_LootLockout.ListInstanceBinds() gives the portrait menu's Reset Instances list from it, one entry per map and difficulty. Entering a normal dungeon binds the player to that instance until it is reset. Expected: a player without binds gets an empty OK list; after entering and leaving Deadmines the list names one Deadmines bind.

steps.label: A player without binds gets an empty list
